purpose: New object candidates collected for review before expanding the production classifier.

classes.label: Hair clip
classes.note: Plastic or mixed-material hair accessories are treated as general waste unless a local collection stream says otherwise.

classes.label: Phone case
classes.note: Add silicone, TPU, hard plastic, clear, damaged and dirty cases.

classes.label: Clothing and fabric
classes.note: Keep worn clothing, socks, fabric scraps and torn textiles distinct from clean reusable donation items.

classes.label: Comb
classes.note: Collect standalone plastic combs, broken combs and close-up phone photos.

classes.label: Broken toy
classes.note: Do not use broken-heart graphics or injury photos as toy examples.

classes.label: Keychain
classes.note: Mixed plastic, fabric and metal keychains are a general-waste candidate.

classes.label: Cosmetic sponge
classes.note: Keep makeup sponges separate from makeup brushes, palettes and cosmetics.

classes.label: Broken ceramic
classes.note: Use real shards, broken mugs and plates; do not use paintings or diagrams.

classes.label: Birthday candle
classes.note: Use loose wax candles, used candles and candle pieces, not birthday cards or balloon graphics.

classes.label: Phone charger and adapter
classes.note: Treat as e-waste or special collection, not Landfill.

classes.label: Pen, marker and highlighter
classes.note: Include empty, broken and used writing tools; do not include pencils made only of paper and wood without checking local rules.

classes.label: Colored pencil and crayon
classes.note: Include colored pencils, crayons and short used pieces.

classes.label: Eraser
classes.note: Include worn, dirty and broken erasers.

classes.label: Ruler
classes.note: Focus on plastic and mixed-material rulers, especially broken ones.

classes.label: Glue, correction tape and sticky tape
classes.note: Keep glue sticks, correction tape and used tape as separate visual variants in the review notes.

classes.label: Notebook and exercise book
classes.note: Collect worn or discarded notebooks, including spiral-bound and partially used examples.
